instructions: You are working on GymCoach - a self-hosted fitness tracker with AI coach. Read CLAUDE.md before making any change. Always run `bash scripts/verify.sh` (green-gate) before committing. Stack: Next.js 15 App Router, TypeScript strict, Tailwind, Shadcn UI, Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL 16. Never commit to main. Branch naming: feat/issue-<n>-<slug> or fix/issue-<n>-<slug>.

gymcoach-db.description: Direct PostgreSQL access to the GymCoach database. Use for schema inspection, data queries and migration debugging.

context7.description: Live documentation for Next.js, Prisma, Tailwind, Shadcn UI, Zod and other dependencies. Always resolve library-id before writing code that uses a dependency.

filesystem.description: Read and write files in the GymCoach project directory.

composio.description: Composio integration hub: YouTube (search/upload), Google Sheets (nutrition export), Gmail (notifications), Slack, Notion. Run `npx composio-core login` once to authenticate via OAuth.
